gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-imprima: Imprima keeps its lines smooth and tube-like, with terminals that flare outward at the ends. And Bruno Ace SC is the show-off, spacing its open letters like beads on a thread, while the plain sans below simply gets on with being friendly.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-jost: Jost draws every stroke at a single unit width, with broad gaps at the terminals. Jost's quiet, orderly lines let Bruno Ace SC, with its bead-spaced and open letters, be the one thing that stands out.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-kantumruy-pro: Kantumruy Pro is a sans-serif with hairline-free, swell-free letterforms, and an e whose eye opens clearly to the right. Bruno Ace SC spreads out above it.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-koho: Expressive and wide-spaced, Bruno Ace SC gives every stroke the same visual weight. KoHo is the quieter partner, with wide openings in its c and a low-key sans texture that does the steady work of carrying the text.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-m-plus-2: Bruno Ace SC strings its open letters out like beads on a long thread, with no calligraphic thinning anywhere. And M PLUS 2 follows as a plain sans with a gaping c opening and one fixed nib width.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-m-plus-rounded-1c: Wide-spaced letters, drawn with a fixed pen. Bruno Ace SC and M PLUS Rounded 1c share a friendly openness, since the body's terminals stop short of curling back in, and that gentle agreement is what holds them together.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-mandali: Bruno Ace SC is a skeleton outline given one fixed stroke thickness. Mandali, a plain sans with a generous entry into the e's eye, would keep text feeling friendly and unhurried well down the page.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-manjari: Beaded, open letters with no thinning: that is Bruno Ace SC. Manjari, a sans-serif with wide, unclosed terminals and an unvarying line weight, would read smoothly and approachably, paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-mona-sans: Mona Sans is a sans-serif whose letter openings are as wide as a door left ajar. Its best quality is how plainly it lets Bruno Ace SC, with thickness that stays put around curves, take the spotlight.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-noto-sans-cypriot: Traced with one thickness, spaced like beads. Bruno Ace SC is the expressive one, while Noto Sans Cypriot, a sans-serif whose e opens up rather than closing its eye, is the one that quietly does the reading.
